newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stable in slow late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stable in slow late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar in late trading on Wednesday, dealers said.
One U.S. bank dealer said there was some dollars buying up to a high of 2,338.75 before the central bank fixing.
But the dollar later eased back after Bank Indonesia kept its intervention rate at 2,338/2,530 and the conversion rate at 2,338/2,386 on Wednesday, the dealer said.
"Sentiment remains firm on the rupiah. There is generally no drive in the market to trade," one Japanese bank dealer said.
Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,338.3/38.4 at 0900 GMT against an opening of 2,338.25/39.25.
Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,337.85/38.05 and 2,337.25/37.70 respectively.
The U.S. bank dealer said operators were rather mixed over liquidity outlook in the short-term, which kept longer-term swap rates fluctuative.
He said the market was also mixed over the possible impact on market liquidity on Thursday when unsuccesful applicants of Bank Negara Indonesia shares will be refunded their money.
Overnight swap was at 0.4/0.5 and tom/next at 0.45/0.47.
One-month swap was at 15.50/16.00, two at 30.75/32.00, three at 48.00/48.25 and six at 91.25/92.00 points.
